title: Use Bluetooth Meter always OFF
symptom: User cannot switch 'Use Bluetooth Meter' to ON in Settings > Glucose Meters, even after scanning and pairing a Contour Next One meter. The option remains OFF and other options on that page are unselectable.
cause: The user found that the xDrip app lacked the 'contacts' permission, which was required for the Bluetooth pairing/retrieval process to work.
fix: The user granted the 'contacts' permission to xDrip, after which scanning for the Contour meter downloaded its data and allowed enabling 'Use Bluetooth Meter'.
evidence_quote: I just tried allowing "contacts", and now when I scan for the Contour GM it does download all the current info from the device (as jamorham said it should in an earlier message). And, I can turn on "Use Bluetooth Monitor".
